EC2: Patients with serious and unstable illnesses including current hepatic [OR], renal [OR], gastroenterologic [OR], respiratory [OR], cardiovascular [OR] (including ischemic heart disease [OR] and congestive heart failure), endocrinologic [OR], neurologic (including stroke [OR], transient ischemic attack [OR], subarachnoidal bleeding [OR], brain tumor [OR], encephalopathy [OR], and meningitis).
EC3: Patients with a history of allergic reactions to loxapine [OR] or amoxapine
EC4: Patients who have received an investigational drug within 30 days prior to the current agitation episode must be excluded.
EC5: Patients who are considered by the investigator, for any reason, to be unable to self-administer the inhalation device.
